# goslop text fixture (.txt) — materialized to .py at test/runtime
lang: python
file: CWE-79-vulnerable.py
---
"""CWE-79 vulnerable: mark_safe / Markup / render_template_string dynamic."""

from django.utils.safestring import mark_safe
from flask import render_template_string
from markupsafe import Markup


def paint(user_html: str):
    return mark_safe(user_html)


def paint_markup(q: str):
    return Markup(q)


def paint_string(name: str):
    return render_template_string(f"<h1>{name}</h1>")
